source.snippet: I am a solo founder building a hardware startup and my least favorite thing to do is developing and prototyping a new PCB. Soldering by hand takes hours but I don't make enough of the same kind of board to justify getting any commercial PnP system. I wish there was a tool where I could: 1. Upload a BOM 2. Receive a DXF for laser cutting that arranged all my tapes (off Mouser/Digikey) in some rows or columns 3. Place my board in some spot on a Cartesian motion system 4. Peel open the [tape]...

problem_statement: Solo hardware founders and small electronics prototypers cannot justify the cost of commercial pick-and-place machines but spend many hours hand-soldering PCB prototypes; there is no affordable, semi-automated solution bridging hand assembly and industrial PnP systems.
target_segment: Solo hardware founders, indie PCB designers, and small electronics labs producing low-volume prototype runs
notes: Very concrete pain description with a detailed feature wishlist from the author. Niche but high-intensity pain. Could be a SaaS tool generating laser-cut templates + motion system software, or a hardware kit.
